patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Drip and Moosend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Drip only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from” rather than Moosend's shape. Choose Moosend only if your buying job matches “Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited sends.” rather than Drip's shape. Workflow advantage: Drip leans ecommerce-email; Moosend leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Drip and Moosend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Drip is Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from $39/mo.; Moosend is Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited sends..
- Company-size focus: Drip (small-business, mid-market) vs Moosend (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Drip-leaning ecommerce-email vs Moosend-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Drip — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Moosend — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry.

Limitations — Drip: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Contact-tier pricing rises as the store list grows; Moosend: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry; Exact contact-tier dollars require the live calculator.

Poor-fit cases: Drip is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo · Moosend is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry · Avoid Drip if you actually need Moosend's motion (Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
